level_definitions.level1_cue_marginal: Average of per-cue training statistics over legal pre_surface cues present in the held-out signature.
level_definitions.level2_knn_jaccard: Top-3 nearest training signatures by Jaccard overlap over legal pre_surface cues.
level_definitions.level3_subset_candidate: Aggregate over maximal training signatures whose cue set is a subset of the held-out signature.
level_definitions.global_fallback: Training-wide aggregate over all training objects in the split/condition/cost.
